title: Browser status-aware pit-loss estimate sidecar
description: Optional per-fixture, per-track pit-loss estimates. Legacy race-derived timelines and curated replay-start baselines are both readable.
$comment: Legacy sidecars use track-status-median-v1 and causal observedSampleCount arrays. Curated sidecars use curated-track-baseline-v1 and contain only immutable Green/VSC/SC replay-start values. Catalog audit metadata (sourceStatus, provenance, evidence, confidence, and derivation details) remains in the internal catalog and never enters a sidecar payload. Curated sidecars require available replay-start timelines for all three statuses (statusEstimate unavailable is a legacy-only shape). Every object uses additionalProperties: false, so unknown catalog fields fail schema validation. The curated SC <= VSC <= Green monotonic invariant is enforced by the pipeline model and publication because Draft 2020-12 cannot express cross-property numeric ordering portably.

estimateTimeline.$comment: A legacy timeline begins with the estimate available before its first observed sample. Equal array lengths, strict time ordering, nondecreasing sample counts, status occurrence/availability, and causal completion are semantic publication rules because Draft 2020-12 cannot express those relationships portably.

curatedEstimateTimeline.$comment: A curated timeline contains exactly one value at replay start and never carries observedSampleCount: current-race observation counts must not be fabricated for catalog values.

curatedStatusEstimate.$comment: Curated sidecars require available replay-start timelines for Green, SC, and VSC; the unavailable status is a legacy-only shape and must not appear here.
